beats.text: Waiting for a new phone feels like impatience. Waiting for a trip feels like happiness.
Researchers pinged over two thousand people at random moments and asked what they were thinking about.
People looking forward to an experience were happier than people looking forward to a thing.
Even news reports agreed: people in line for experiences were in better moods than people in line for stuff.
So book the trip early. The waiting is part of the gift.

sources: Kumar, Killingsworth & Gilovich (2014). Waiting for Merlot: Anticipatory consumption of experiential and material purchases. Psychological Science 25(10). Experience sampling with 2,266 adults; anticipating experiences was more pleasant/exciting than anticipating material goods; news accounts of queues showed better moods for experiences. Via APS.
